results.title: Taken at a Truck Stop: A Black Girl Missing Movie
results.original_title: Taken at a Truck Stop: A Black Girl Missing Movie
results.overview: Kai is thrown into a harrowing manhunt after her sister Madison’s neurodivergent daughter is abducted by an online predator. Kai leverages her loyal trucking network and social media influence to launch a grassroots rescue mission to find her niece.

results.title: The Unrestricted War
results.overview: A top-tier Canadian virologist and his Chinese wife are suddenly arrested by military secret agents in Beijing. He is threatened with the task of stealing a sample of his own work from his former laboratory, and the situation rapidly turns worse when people begin to fall ill.

results.title: Cloture
results.overview: A comedy film about surrogacy and the problems that arise for the family in this way so that they can handle their financial problems, but this is just the beginning of the problems.

results.title: Мarine Education
results.overview: Cadets of the Naval School have an internship on the training ship Nadezhda. As young men, they adapt to the harsh realities of the sea, strengthening their will and developing a true masculine character.

results.title: Dinnerplate
results.overview: In the outskirts of Normandy, a young German soldier is found by three americans. The young boy finds himself stuck on a landmine, and begging to go home. Will the enemy show him mercy?

results.title: Dressed to the Nines
results.overview: A coming-of-age short film about a young boy who believes dressing up to the nines will keep his mum with him forever.

results.title: Sand in Your Hair
results.overview: Malvina, a once celebrated ballerina now in her mid-eighties, now languishes in a monotonous routine. After she unexpectedly meets Kipras, a talented painter of her age, he becomes the catalyst for change. Together, they defy society's expectations about seniors, transcending age and challenging taboos. As they escape from relatives and institutions, they discover that freedom isn't merely physical; it's about breaking free from invisible chains. Their journey unfolds as a pas de deux – a dance of resilience, rebellion and redemption.

results.title: AKI
results.overview: As the years go by, it gets harder for dancer and theatre director Aki to live an artistic life. But against the odds, she perseveres.  Aki is struggling to continue her lifelong work as a dancer, actress and theatre director, while at the same time caring for her ageing father. As a series of international performances are cancelled, we witness doubts swirling on the surface and a steely resilience within. As life challenges collide with the trials of the creative process, this film is a sensitive contemplation on what we can control in our lives and what remains out of our hands. It's a film that explores creativity, authenticity and how to keep true to yourself as the years go by.

results.title: Sonman
results.overview: A teacher’s quiet act of kindness in paying a student’s exam fee leaves a lasting impact, inspiring the grown student to search for him years later.

results.title: Obelisk: Bunker to Beacon and Back (and admiration for Paul Rudolph's Mental Health Center)
results.original_title: Obelisk: Bunker to Beacon and Back (and admiration for Paul Rudolph's Mental Health Center)
results.overview: A place is an obelisk, reaching to the sky; down again to a point in the ground. Not a solid point, but a hesitant, mysterious one (some say always shifting). Ripples of life arch out from its base in unexpected ways. The obelisk series is an informal collecting of time and place haphazardly documented by two perambulating filmmakers.

results.title: A Dawn To Live In
results.overview: The story follows the family of Virginia, a nurse who brings her teenage sons to their father's private school to be safe during COVID-19 lockdown. This also functions as a pretext for Virginia to get close to her ex-husband, Pablo, who has been living at the school for some time. Once inside, each son smuggles in his girlfriend without the adult's consent, unaware of the intimate secrets that will come to light and change everyone's fate.

results.title: Madhuram Jeevamruthabindu
results.overview: Explores Different Shades Of Human Desire Through Jessie, Ilyas, Samuel, And Bhaskaran - Each Chasing Passion, Longing, Or Curiosity In Their Own Way, Revealing How Desires Shape Life And Lead To Self-Realisation.

results.title: Children No More: Were and Are Gone
results.original_title: Children No More: Were and Are Gone
results.overview: In Tel Aviv, activists gather weekly to demonstrate their opposition to the war in Gaza with a silent vigil for the children killed in Israeli attacks.

results.title: Can You Feel the Beat: The Lisa Lisa Story
results.original_title: Can You Feel the Beat: The Lisa Lisa Story
results.overview: 15-year-old Puerto Rican Lisa Velez overcomes sexism, racism, and breast cancer to become Latin pop pioneer behind hits like "Can You Feel The Beat," inspiring generations of Latina artists.

results.title: A Place for Pierrot
results.overview: Pierrot, 50, is autistic and lives in a care home. His sister Camille, 45, discovers that he is being overmedicated, causing him to regress. Outraged, she decides to take him into her home while she searches for a place that is better suited to his needs. A long quest begins.

results.title: My Fighter
results.overview: A retired boxer turned coach battles with the guilt of an accident years ago, in which he paralyzed his opponent and decides to make amends once and for all.

results.title: Dheeram
results.overview: A police officer investigates pattern killings in Calicut, discovering a vengeful killer's scheme. As he unravels the truth, he faces a moral dilemma between law and justice for a bereaved parent.
